tasks.analysis: Researchers in the U.S. and Europe are taking a fresh look at some of the natural compounds found in rainwater and soil for possible medicinal applications. High - tech instruments are used to identify and extract natural products from dirt and water; the hope is that this process will lead to the discovery of new antibiotics. Although the work is painstakingly slow at present, these researchers hope to develop technologies that will allow them to quickly isolate promising compounds that could be effective treatments for often - devastating bacterial infections. 美国和欧洲的研究人员正在重新审视雨水和土壤中发现的一些天然化合物，探索其潜在的药用价值。他们借助高科技仪器从泥土和水中识别并提取天然产物，希望这一过程能助力新抗生素的发现。尽管目前这项工作进展极为缓慢，但研究人员们期待能研发出相关技术，从而快速分离出具有潜力的化合物 —— 这些化合物或许能成为治疗往往极具破坏性的细菌感染的有效疗法。
